## JetBlue Expands TrueBlue® Benefits for 2027, Bringing Space-Available Upgrades to All Mosaic® Members


10/22/2026


Download (opens in new window)


*Enhanced benefits include more premium upgrade opportunities, new rewards for top-tier Mosaic members and exclusive value for JetBlue Premier Cardmembers*


**What's New for 2027:**


- **BlueFirst™ Upgrades:** Complimentary, space-available upgrades for all Mosaic tiers1 and eligible JetBlue Premier Cardmembers to JetBlue’s new domestic first class.
- **More Premium Upgrade Options:** Certificates can be used for Mint® or BlueFirst seating.
- **Enhanced Mosaic Rewards:** More points, perks and opportunities to share benefits.
- **New Premier Card Exclusives:** Companion travel benefits, status gifting and additional points.
- **Greater Flexibility:** Reselect favorite Perks You Pick benefits at future milestones.


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


JetBlue (Nasdaq: JBLU) today announced a significant expansion of its TrueBlue® loyalty program beginning February 1, 2027, including complimentary, space-available BlueFirst upgrades for all Mosaic® members, greater flexibility with Perks You Pick® and exclusive new benefits for JetBlue Premier Cardmembers.


“TrueBlue is built around our customers, and we’ve continued to evolve the program by listening to the members who fly us most,” said Ed Pouthier, vice president, loyalty and personalization, JetBlue. “These updates reflect what they’ve told us matters: meaningful benefits, greater flexibility and more value as their relationship with JetBlue grows. Loyalty is a two-way relationship, and we’re committed to recognizing and rewarding our members every step of the way.”


**More Value for Mosaic Members** JetBlue is expanding benefits across all four Mosaic levels in 2027, giving its most loyal customers more opportunities to enjoy premium experiences and unlock additional rewards.


- **Complimentary BlueFirst Upgrades:** For the first time, members at every Mosaic level, and up to one traveling companion on the same reservation, will be eligible for complimentary, space-available upgrades to BlueFirst, JetBlue's new domestic first-class experience, when traveling on eligible fares. JetBlue Premier Cardmembers will also be eligible for space-available upgrades when they use their Premier Card to book eligible fares. ¹ For more information on space-available upgrades, visit[jetblue.com/trueblue/space-available-upgrades](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jetblue.com%2Ftrueblue%2Fspace-available-upgrades&esheet=54627266&newsitemid=20261022480742&lan=en-US&anchor=jetblue.com%2Ftrueblue%2Fspace-available-upgrades&index=1&md5=4e1e7f98669c515ac9c54360b2b4ce6d) .
- **More Ways to Upgrade:** Premium Upgrade Certificates, formerly known as Move to Mint ® certificates, can be used by eligible members for Mint ® or BlueFirst seating, where available. Mosaic 2 members can select one certificate through Perks You Pick, while Mosaic 3 and Mosaic 4 members will continue to receive certificates as part of their benefits. Mosaic 4 members can also earn additional certificates for every 100 additional Tiles earned.
- **Enhanced Top-Tier Rewards:** Mosaic 3 and Mosaic 4 members will have access to expanded Perks You Pick options, including larger points bonuses, additional upgrade opportunities and new ways to share benefits with other TrueBlue members. Mosaic 4 members can also select benefits such as the ability to gift Mosaic 3 status or the ability to gift BlueHouse Lounge Membership.


**More Ways to Reward JetBlue Premier Cardmembers** JetBlue is introducing exclusive new benefits for eligible Premier Cardmembers at every Mosaic milestone, offering more ways to earn rewards, share benefits and get greater value from everyday spending.


- **Share the Benefits:** Depending on their Mosaic level, Premier Cardmembers can select exclusive perks, including the ability to gift Tiles or Mosaic status to another TrueBlue member.
- **Companion Travel Benefits:** Primary Premier Cardmembers who reach Mosaic 3 or Mosaic 4 can select a companion travel benefit providing up to $500 or $1,500, respectively, as a statement credit toward an eligible companion booking made with the Premier Card.
- **More Points on Everyday Purchases:** Premier Cardmembers who reach Mosaic 3 or Mosaic 4 will earn an additional 3x points, for a total of **5x TrueBlue points per $1 spent at eligible grocery stores and restaurants** , on up to $50,000 in combined eligible purchases each calendar year.


**Greater Flexibility with Perks You Pick** Beginning in 2027, TrueBlue members will have more freedom to choose the benefits that matter most to them. Members can reselect a favorite perk at subsequent eligible Tile milestones rather than being limited to choosing each perk only once, with 60 days after reaching each milestone to make their selection.


Before reaching Mosaic status, TrueBlue members can also choose perks for their next eligible flight, including early boarding, an alcoholic beverage, priority security, bonus points and bonus tiles.


**2027 Perks You Pick Benefits by Mosaic Level** Members can select one benefit at each eligible milestone and, beginning in 2027, may reselect a favorite benefit at subsequent milestones.


**Mosaic Level**


**Perks You Pick Enhancements**


**Premier Cardmember Exclusive Perks**


**Mosaic 1**


- 10,000-Point Bonus
- 10-Tile Bonus
- 10-Tile Bonus Head Start 2
- One BlueHouse Lounge Pass


- Gift a 10-Tile Bonus


**Mosaic 2**


- 10,000-Point Bonus
- 10-Tile Bonus
- 10-Tile Bonus Head Start 2
- One BlueHouse Lounge Pass
- One Premium Upgrade Certificate


- Gift Mosaic 1 status


**Mosaic 3**


- 20,000-Point Bonus
- 20-Tile Bonus
- 20-Tile Bonus Head Start 2
- One BlueHouse Lounge Pass
- One Premium Upgrade Certificate


- Gift Mosaic 2 status
- Companion travel benefit providing up to $500 as a statement credit toward an eligible companion booking — *Primary Premier Cardmembers Only*


**Mosaic 4**


- 30,000-Point Bonus
- 30-Tile Bonus Head Start 2
- One BlueHouse Lounge Pass
- One Premium Upgrade Certificate
- Gift Mosaic 3 status
- Gift a BlueHouse Lounge Membership


- Companion travel benefit providing up to $1,500 as a statement credit toward an eligible companion booking — *Primary Premier Cardmembers Only*


The TrueBlue changes take effect February 1, 2027. Full benefit details, eligibility requirements and terms will be available at[jetblue.com/trueblue/mosaic/on-the-horizon-2027](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jetblue.com%2Ftrueblue%2Fmosaic%2Fon-the-horizon-2027&esheet=54627266&newsitemid=20261022480742&lan=en-US&anchor=jetblue.com%2Ftrueblue%2Fmosaic%2Fon-the-horizon-2027&index=2&md5=770ff643c39fe1254d923a5838e75180) .


**About JetBlue**


JetBlue is New York's Hometown Airline® and a leading carrier in Boston, Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood, Los Angeles, Orlando and San Juan. JetBlue carries customers to more than 100 destinations throughout the United States, Latin America, the Caribbean, Canada and Europe. For more information and the best fares, visit[jetblue.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jetblue.com%2F&esheet=54627266&newsitemid=20261022480742&lan=en-US&anchor=jetblue.com&index=3&md5=37ae3a0304a78a443e7878cca2ff213e) .


1. BlueFirst upgrades are complimentary and subject to availability. Main Base and EvenMore Base fare choices are not eligible. BlueFirst may be available only on select flights or dates, including on an intermittent basis. Additional eligibility requirements and restrictions apply.
2. Bonus Tiles as part of the Tile Bonus Head Start will be added to the TrueBlue member's Tile count in the next sequential program year.
